scope: Unapplied local candidate v2; no repository/remote source mutation and no runtime qualification.
new_admission_bounds: Both read and write admission use existing WAIT=10s; no product timeout or 60ms no_connection change.
selected_design: Every ChildOwner owns a shared lifetime lease through collect/reap or Drop wait. The exclusive release barrier waits for all potential inheritors to exit, rejects the monotonic reap-failure flag, then performs original drop plus one Tokio bind and drops that probe under the same guard.
